title: fix(catalog): cap vercel muse-spark-1.3-contributor output tokens
body:
## Repro
Every chat request to `vercel-ai-gateway/meta/muse-spark-1.3-contributor` fails with HTTP 400 `"The request contains invalid parameters"`. Vercel reports both `context_window` and `max_tokens` as `1048576`, so omp posts `max_tokens=1048576` to `ai-gateway.vercel.sh/v1/messages`; prompt plus requested output then exceeds the shared 1M context window and the gateway 400s (`1048576` -> 400, `65536` -> 200). Reproduced against `main`:

```
$ bun -e 'import("@oh-my-pi/pi-catalog/build").then(({buildModel})=>console.log(buildModel({id:"meta/muse-spark-1.3-contributor",api:"anthropic-messages",provider:"vercel-ai-gateway",baseUrl:"https://ai-gateway.vercel.sh",contextWindow:1048576,maxTokens:1048576,reasoning:true,input:["text"],cost:{input:1,output:3,cacheRead:0.2,cacheWrite:1},name:"x"}).maxTokens))'
1048576
```

## Cause
The only output cap for this provider was a hardcoded `modelId === "meta/muse-spark-1.2-contributor"` branch in `vercelAiGatewayModelManagerOptions` (`packages/catalog/src/provider-models/openai-compat.ts`), added by #9115. The sibling `meta/muse-spark-1.3-contributor` was never covered, so its Vercel-reported `maxTokens` flowed through uncapped into both live discovery and the bundled `models.json` row.

## Fix
- Add a `limits-patch { max-tokens 131072 }` rule for `meta/muse-spark-1.2-contributor` and `meta/muse-spark-1.3-contributor` in `packages/catalog/src/compat/rules/providers/vercel-ai-gateway.kdl`, so the cap is applied by `buildModel` on both runtime discovery and catalog generation (context window left at the reported `1048576`).
- Remove the hardcoded id special-case from the Vercel discovery mapper.
- Regenerate `packages/catalog/src/compat/rules.json` (`bun run gen:compat`) and cap the bundled `vercel-ai-gateway/meta/muse-spark-1.3-contributor` `maxTokens` to `131072` (the value a full `gen:models` produces from the new rule; single-line change mirroring #9115).
- Rewrite `packages/catalog/test/vercel-ai-gateway-provider.test.ts` to assert the built-model contract (`maxTokens=131072`, `contextWindow=1048576`) for both contributor SKUs, that the non-contributor `meta/muse-spark-1.3` stays uncapped, and that a control model is untouched.

## Verification
`bun test` in `packages/catalog` — 869 pass / 0 fail. `bun run check:types` clean. Post-fix `buildModel` returns `maxTokens=131072` for both contributor SKUs and `1048576` for `meta/muse-spark-1.3`; bundled `models.json` diff is a single line.

Fixes #10705

title: Add direct Meta Model API support for Muse Spark
body: ## Outcome Implements the hosted portion of [#317 (direct Meta Model API support for Muse Spark and future open-weight evaluation)](https://github.com/darwin-finch/finch/issues/317) under the [accepted Tier-3 contract](https://github.com/darwin-finch/finch/issues/317#issuecomment-5928391500). - Adds first-class `meta_model_api` credential/provider vocabulary with a named Bearer credential bound to `https://api.meta.ai`. - Pins chat and discovery to `/v1/chat/completions` and `/v1/models`; endpoint/path overrides and undocumented future model IDs fail before secret resolution. - Supports the current standard `muse-spark-1.3` identity, streamed text, fragmented function arguments, parallel tool calls, reasoning effort, bounded 429/5xx retry, cancellation, strict event/body bounds, and secret-free provider diagnostics. - Keeps existing provider behavior unchanged: Meta-specific rate-limit retry and strict wire handling are selected only by the fixed Meta transport. - Documents the dated boundary among direct Meta Model API, OpenCode Zen, Muse Code, contributor-tier models, and unavailable future/local Muse Spark weights. - Adds an explicitly guarded ignored live fixture. No paid/live request was made. Official Meta sources were rechecked on 2026-10-01 and did not contradict the accepted contract: - https://dev.meta.ai/docs/overview - https://dev.meta.ai/docs/protocols/chat-completions - https://dev.meta.ai/docs/api-reference/chat-completions/schemas - https://dev.meta.ai/docs/pricing-rate-limits - https://dev.meta.ai/models/muse-spark ## Regression evidence Fail-before command: ```text ./scripts/test_brains.sh cargo test -p finch --lib config::provider::tests::test_meta_model_api_named_profile_roundtrips -- --exact ``` Before the implementation, the new round-trip regression rejected `provider = "meta_model_api"` because that credential/provider vocabulary did not exist. It now passes through the real persisted configuration type. Production-boundary mock coverage proves: - exact chat/discovery paths, content type, Bearer audience, and request fields; - current model metadata plus streamed text/tool identity; - two parallel tool calls with arguments fragmented across events; - malformed and oversized event failure without completion; - cancellation closes the transport without publishing late success; - bounded retries for HTTP 429 and 503, with deterministic 4xx failure; - response-body redaction and secret-free actionable authentication errors; - current-only model and fixed-origin/path preflight before secret resolution. ## Verification Passed: ```text ./scripts/test_brains.sh cargo test -p finch-providers --lib meta_model_api -- --nocapture # 7 passed; 1 ignored ./scripts/test_brains.sh cargo test -p finch-providers --lib # 415 passed; 3 ignored ./scripts/test_brains.sh cargo test -p finch --lib meta_ -- --nocapture # 2 passed ./scripts/test_brains.sh cargo test -p finch --lib -- providers:: # 49 passed ./scripts/test_brains.sh cargo test -p finch --lib -- config:: # 111 passed ./scripts/test_brains.sh cargo test -p finch --test provider_token_binding_test ./scripts/test_brains.sh cargo test -p finch --test provider_config_test # both passed; provider_config_test: 10 passed cargo fmt --all -- --check git diff --check python3 scripts/check_docs.py # 66 current documents passed python3 scripts/check_facade_boundaries.py # facade boundaries intact cargo check -p finch-providers --no-default-features cargo check --workspace --all-targets cargo clippy -p finch-providers --all-targets cargo clippy -p finch --lib ``` `cargo clippy -p finch --lib --tests` was also attempted. It remains red on unrelated pre-existing denied test lints (four errors, including `clippy::unit_cmp` in `src/brain_application_tests.rs:1525`); the production-library clippy gate and the changed provider crate are green. No unrelated lint cleanup is included. Intentionally not run: ```text FINCH_LIVE_META_MODEL_API=1 MODEL_API_KEY=... \ ./scripts/test_brains.sh cargo test -p finch-providers \ live_meta_model_api_muse_spark_acceptance_is_explicitly_opt_in \ -- --ignored --exact ``` That fixture is paid/live and remains ignored by default. ## Rollback Revert this additive provider/config/docs commit. It performs no credential import, persisted-data migration, deletion, billing action, or release operation. --- Need help on this PR? Tag @codesmith-bot with what you need. Autofix is disabled.
